column2: a cream cable-knit CROPPED sweater with long sleeves to the wrists and a round neck, the ribbed hem at her waist above the navel; it completely covers the bandeau; the inside back of the neckline is visible behind her neck.

a loose lilac hoodie with long sleeves to the wrists, a kangaroo pocket, a drawstring hood lying flat behind her neck and shoulders (the hood is in the back layer, visible around her neck); the ribbed hem sits at her natural waist; it completely covers her chest and the bandeau.

a white silk blouse with long sleeves to the wrists, a soft pointed collar and small buttons, the hem at the hips; it completely covers the bandeau; the inside back of the collar is visible behind her neck.
a fitted black strapless mini cocktail dress from above the bust to mid-thigh, its straight top edge high enough to cover the bandeau completely; it completely covers the briefs, also at the hips.

a floor-length emerald-green sequined evening gown with thin straps and a soft V neckline and a high side slit on her left leg (viewer's right) showing the leg; the hem reaches the floor around the feet; it completely covers the briefs; the inner back of the gown is visible through the slit and below the hem between her feet.

a yellow floral sundress with wide shoulder straps, a square neckline covering the bandeau completely and a flared skirt ending above the knees; it completely covers the briefs; the inner back of the skirt is visible between her legs below the hem.

a very short textured platinum-blonde pixie cut with a soft side-swept fringe; the hair hugs the head (at most 10 pixels outside her hair cap) and completely covers the cap, also at the temples; ears fully visible; at the back the hair is cropped short at the nape and does NOT hang down beside the jaw or neck.

a fitted camel-colour blazer with long sleeves to the wrists, notch lapels and ONE button at the waist; the lapels form a deep open V neckline from the shoulders down to the button, and inside the V her bare chest shows: those pixels are fully transparent in the front layer (no lining, no shirt, no camel fabric between the lapels); the hem at the hips; the inside back of the collar is visible behind her neck.

a fitted black sleeveless tube top with a straight wide boat neckline from shoulder to shoulder, hem at her natural waist, completely covering the bandeau; over it a cropped dark-burgundy open-knit crochet shrug (bolero) with thin black stripes, covering the shoulders and the upper chest, with long sleeves down to the wrists that flare slightly; through the open crochet holes of the sleeves her arms show (those holes are transparent in the front layer); the inside back of the shrug's neckline is visible behind her neck. IMPORTANT: the front layer is NOT a product shot - it is the garment exactly where it sits on her body in step 1, same size and position, the rest of the canvas transparent.

a baby-pink satin halter-neck crop top: two triangular cups meeting in a V neckline, thin ties going round the back of her neck, a small sparkly rhinestone butterfly at the bottom of the V, the fitted hem band just under the bust; her shoulders and arms are bare; it completely covers the bandeau; the ties behind her neck are in the back layer.

a lilac iridescent satin mini slip dress with a soft cowl neckline, thin spaghetti straps over her shoulders and a narrow white lace trim at the hem, fitted to her body and ending at mid-thigh; it completely covers the bandeau and the briefs, also at the hips.

a cropped baby-blue fuzzy mohair cardigan with long sleeves down to the wrists and a round neck, closed with small white heart-shaped buttons, the hem at her natural waist; it completely covers the bandeau; the inside back of the neckline is visible behind her neck. IMPORTANT: the front layer is NOT a product shot - it is the cardigan exactly where it sits on her body in step 1, same size and position, the rest of the canvas transparent.

sleek straight shoulder-length dark chocolate-brown hair with a deep side part, completely covering her dark hair cap, hugging the head (at most 10 pixels outside the cap on top); the ends rest on her shoulders. Above her right temple (viewer's left) the hair is swept back and held by a neat row of four small pastel snap hair clips placed one under another: pink, lilac, mint, pink. The clips are clearly a different colour from the hair. Behind her neck the back of the hair is visible between the ends.

glossy jet-black hair twisted into a neat round bun high on the back of the crown, smooth over the skull (at most 10 pixels outside her hair cap besides the bun), completely covering the cap, two thin loose strands framing the face; two slim cherry-red lacquered hair sticks are pushed crosswise through the bun and stick out diagonally above and beside her head. The sticks are clearly red, not black.

a modern shag mullet in cool ash-brown: short choppy layers on top with soft curtain bangs, the hair hugging the head (at most 12 pixels outside her hair cap on top), completely covering the cap; at the sides it is cut short above the jaw, and at the back longer wispy layers fall from the nape down onto her neck and the tops of her shoulders, visible on both sides of her neck.

two playful round space buns high on the top of the head, one on each side of a middle part, in warm copper-ginger; the rest of the hair smooth over the skull completely covering her dark hair cap, with two thin wavy face-framing strands hanging beside her cheeks to the chin. The buns are small and neat (each about as wide as her eye-to-eye distance).

long soft honey-blonde waves in a half-up style, the hair close to the head on top (at most 12 pixels outside her hair cap) and falling smoothly over both shoulders down to the chest, no wider than her shoulders; completely covering her dark hair cap. At the back of the crown the top section is tied with a medium baby-pink satin bow (about as wide as her face), visible just above the top of her head; short ribbon tails hidden behind the hair. The bow is clearly pink, not hair-coloured.
